summary: A collection of music games for the FM-1, laid out as a seaside arcade: walk along the boardwalk and play cabinets that train timing, pitch, rhythm and melody.
features: 18 cabinets incl. falling tiles, ear-training, chord finding, change ringing
Games are played on the keys; KNOB 1 picks level or mode
Tickets from each round traded for prizes at a counter
Each game keeps its best score
Reports screen contents over USB to the FM-1 Screen Reader
Falls back to a safe mode after two failed starts
